from pathlib import Path
import collections
program_dir = Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792546011/attempts/063d3d0630cb465fa0dfa1151ed4d5f6/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path = program_dir / 'task-1499e2ef.py'
code = '''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1, len(row) - 1):
            if row[c] == bg and row[c - 1] == row[c + 1] and row[c - 1] != bg:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(code)
print(program_path, program_path.exists())
